title: Check the worker: queues, schedules, e-mails, documents
caption: What to look at while testing anything asynchronous. Redis password and DSN are the development values of .env.example (development only).

steps.title: Worker health
steps.expect: `postgres` and `redis` ok; `queues.<name>.waiting`, `oldestWaitingSeconds`, `failedLastHour` for the eight OTA queues (old jobs never make it 503).

steps.title: Queue contents
steps.body: `redis-cli -a dev_redis --scan --pattern 'vx:ota-*:*' | head`; `redis-cli -a dev_redis llen vx:ota-notifications:wait`; failed jobs: `redis-cli -a dev_redis zrange vx:ota-ticketing:failed 0 -1`.
steps.expect: BullMQ keys under prefix `vx`; failed jobs kept 30 days, completed 1 day (ota-maintenance 1 hour).

steps.title: Schedulers
steps.expect: One scheduler per entry of `OTA_SCHEDULES` (offers.purge, notifications.sweep, payments.authorisation_watch, ticketing.scan, bookings.reconcile_scan, bookings.sync_scan, refunds.sweep, checkouts.expire, retention.daily, queues.poll, customers.erase); log line `scheduler.registered`.

steps.title: E-mail outbox
steps.body: `SELECT template_key, recipient, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error FROM tenant_demo.notifications ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;`
steps.expect: `sent` rows with `secrets_purged_at` set and `secret_payload_ciphertext` NULL; the same e-mails in Mailpit.

steps.title: Documents
steps.body: `SELECT booking_id, kind, status, storage_key, size_bytes FROM tenant_demo.booking_documents ORDER BY created_at DESC;` and look under `.local/storage/tenant_demo/`.
steps.expect: `ready` itinerary and receipts; older versions `superseded`; a `failed` row only with nothing stored.
